item.title: How to use dynamic classes in Vue
item.description: Using dynamic classes in Vue enables conditional styling, interactive UI states, and responsive design patterns based on component data and user interactions. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve implemented dynamic class binding in numerous Vue components for theme switching, active states, and conditional styling in enterprise applications. From my expertise, the most flexible approach is to use Vue’s class binding syntax with objects and arrays. This method provides clean template syntax, reactive class updates, and powerful conditional styling capabilities for complex UI scenarios.
